conventions.frame: metres, glTF Y-up, forward +Z, vehicle right = -X, origin on the ground at the footprint centre
conventions.hierarchy: Transform nodes from the spec (root, hull, turret, gun_pivot, wheel_*, roadwheel_*, sprocket_*, idler_*) are EMPTIES; their geometry is a child mesh named <node>_geo with a sibling <node>_geo_LOD1. This keeps every mesh a leaf so LOD switching by toggling mesh.visible (as soldier.js does) never hides child transforms. track_L/track_R are leaf meshes directly under hull (with track_L_LOD1/track_R_LOD1).
conventions.pivots: turret yaws about local Y at the ring centre; gun_pivot pitches about local X at the trunnion; wheels/roadwheels/sprockets/idlers spin about local X at the hub
conventions.running_gear_parent: wheels, sprockets, idlers and tracks are children of hull (not root) so hiding hull for the wreck swap hides the whole intact vehicle
conventions.hidden_by_default: nodes with extras.hidden = true (three.js userData.hidden): every *_LOD1 and hull_wreck / turret_wreck. The game must set visible=false on load (glTF has no visibility flag).
conventions.wrecks: hull_wreck and turret_wreck are direct children of root (siblings of hull) so the turret wreck can be thrown independently; turret_wreck origin = turret ring centre. BTR wreck sits on bare rims (tyres burnt away, hull dropped ~0.3 m); tank wreck sits 4 cm lower. Wrecks use decimated (~45%) copies of the LOD0 geometry with a burnt material sharing the paint atlas UVs.
conventions.lod: <mesh>_LOD1 = collapse-decimated copy (~30% tris) in the same local space as <mesh>; instanced wheel meshes share one LOD1 mesh.
conventions.materials: <vehicle>_paint: one 2048 atlas (albedo JPEG 2048, ORM PNG 1024 [R=1, G=roughness, B=metalness], normal PNG 1024) for all painted steel, rubber tyres, wood, canvas, MG metal; glass; light_lens; track (alphaMode MASK) ; <vehicle>_wreck + track_wreck for the burnt variants.
conventions.track_uv: track_L/track_R: U = link index along the loop (1.0 per link, 97 links -> U 0..97), V across the profile. Scroll the track material map/normalMap/roughnessMap offset.x by distance_travelled / track_link_pitch_m (sign by direction; L and R share the material, so clone it per side for skid steering). Guide horns and the gaps between links are alpha-tested, so they scroll with the texture.
conventions.cope_cage: t72b3 only: separate mesh node turret/cope_cage (+LOD1) so the game can toggle it.
conventions.empties: muzzle, coax_muzzle under gun_pivot; smoke_launchers and (tanks) commander_hatch under turret; exhaust, dismount_L, dismount_R and (BTR) commander_hatch under hull. Tank dismount_L/R mark crew bail-out points beside the hull. hatch_<role> (commander, gunner, driver, + cargo_* / bow_*): crew hatch rim centres (bail-out start points), under turret or hull.
conventions.ride_seats: Desant riding positions: empties ride_seat_1..N under hull (BTR: 8, T-72: 6), listed per vehicle in ride_seats. Origin = point under the rider pelvis on the sitting surface; local +Z = direction the rider faces, +Y = up. extras.seat_type: "edge" = sitting on a deck edge / fender bin with the legs hanging over the side (thighs along +Z, knees ~0.44 m out, shins down; on the BTR the upper hull side below the roof edge slopes outward ~39 deg, so angle the shins out ~30 deg) or "deck" = sitting on the deck, legs forward along +Z (knees up). Seats parent to hull, so riders follow hull motion; turret traverse never reaches them (ride_clearance.turret_sweep_radius_m vs min_rider_margin_m, cope cage included), but the gun barrel does: ride_clearance.gun_min_elevation_to_clear_riders_deg is the elevation the gun needs before it may traverse over riders; when gun_can_clear_riders is false (T-72) lock the turret to the forward arc while riders are aboard. The rider proxy used for these checks is drawn by tools/blender/vehicles/preview.html?seats=1.
conventions.hatch_lids: Openable crew hatches: every crew hatch lid is a mesh hatch_lid_<role>_geo (+ _LOD1) under a hinge EMPTY hatch_lid_<role> whose origin lies on the hinge axis, parented to turret (turret hatches) or hull (hull hatches). Closed = rotation 0 (identity). vehicles.<name>.hatch_lids.<node> = {role, axis, open, parent, rim}: set node.rotation[axis] = open (radians, three.js local axes of the hinge empty) to open it; interpolate from 0. rim = the hatch_<role> rim-centre empty (bail-out start point; it does not move). Wrecks (hull_wreck / turret_wreck) carry the lids baked in the OPEN pose (crew bailed out).

bohdana.name: 2S22 Bohdana
crew_roles: gunner (cab rear; deployed: gunner_station on the mount, left)
loader (cab rear; deployed: gun_crew_1 on the spade platform)
loader / ammo handler (cab rear; deployed: gun_crew_2..4)
armament: 155 mm L/52 howitzer (8.06 m tube), multi-baffle muzzle brake (muzzle)
bohdana.markings: white crosses on the cab sides, bonnet and cradle sides; green with black-green + khaki disruptive patches
bohdana.chassis: KrAZ-6322/63221 6x6, 4-door armoured crew cab and armoured bonnet (2022-24 field version)

turret.note: open mount, +-30 deg sector over the cab; speed is a game estimate

gun.note: rests on the cab-roof travel lock at 0 deg / traverse 0; depression below 0 only when |traverse| > 20 deg

ammo.stowage: containers on the platform (charges left, shells right)

steps: lift gun off the cab travel lock (elevate >= 5 deg)

animation.frame: glTF node local rotations in radians (three.js), values below in degrees
animation.turret: gun mount turntable: rotation.y = traverse (positive = to the vehicle left), limits -30..+30 deg
animation.gun_pivot: rotation.x = -elevation; limits -5..+65 deg -> rotation.x in [-65, +5] deg; travel pose 0 (barrel on the cab travel lock)
animation.spade_L / spade_R: hinged at the rear frame end, rotate about local X: 0 = folded up for travel (leaning back ~65 deg, teeth pointing back); -85 deg = lowered, blade dug in ~6 cm below ground, top faces = loaders platform sloping 20 deg from 1.0 m (hinge) to 0.55 m (gun_crew_1/2 stand on it)
animation.wheels: wheel_L1..L3 / wheel_R1..R3 spin about local X (hub); front axle (wheel_*1) steers: rotate about local Y with rotation.order = "YXZ"
animation.hatch_lid_commander: commander hatch lid, hinge empty under hull; open = rotation.z POSITIVE (0 .. +1.745 rad); cab roof hatch, hinged on its outer (right) edge so the open lid stands clear of the barrel in the travel lock

hatch_lid_commander.note: cab roof hatch, hinged on its outer (right) edge so the open lid stands clear of the barrel in the travel lock

animated_nodes.hatch_lid_commander: commander hatch lid, hinge empty under hull; open = rotation.z POSITIVE (0 .. +1.745 rad); cab roof hatch, hinged on its outer (right) edge so the open lid stands clear of the barrel in the travel lock

pickup.name: Pickup (casualty evacuation)

casualty_slots.note: origin on the bed floor; local +Z points to the tailgate, so a casualty lying on his back with the head along -Z lies head towards the cab
casualty_slots.load_point: ground behind the open tailgate, +Z faces the truck (medic loading position)

pickup.markings: flat ranger-green repaint; white panels with red crosses on the front doors, canopy sides, tailgate, bonnet and canopy roof; faction ID meshes id_tape (canopy roof tape bands, tinted to the faction tape colour at runtime) and id_ru (white V marks, Russian trucks only); no badges
pickup.variants: shared by UA and RU (medevac.js tints id_tape, shows id_ru for RU)
sources: https://www.toyota.com.au/hilux/specs (Hilux double cab: 5325 x 1855 x 1815 mm, wheelbase 3085 mm, track 1540 mm, 265/65R17)
https://www.mitsubishi-motors.com/en/products/l200 (L200 double cab: 5305 x 1815 x 1780 mm, wheelbase 3000 mm, bed 1520 x 1470 mm)

game.note: unarmoured: rifle fire disables it, any AT round destroys it

tailgate.note: hinge on the bottom edge, opens down to a flat loading shelf at bed-floor height

canopy_door.note: canopy rear lift door, hinge on the roof rear edge, swings up and back (opens together with the tailgate)

pickup.door_animation: door_* / tailgate are hinge empties under hull (closed = rotation 0); set node.rotation[axis] = open (radians) to open, interpolate from 0. Front doors open 68 deg, rear 72 deg, tailgate 90 deg down (flat, at bed-floor height).

steering.note: positive = steer to the vehicle left

ride_seats.note: ride_seat_1 driver (front left, LHD), 2 front passenger, 3 rear right; origin = H-point on the cushion, +Z forward
